catalog_endpoint: Search: https://www.diodeled.com/catalogsearch/result/?q=<SKU> (returns the parent family page). Parent page embeds `new Product.Config({...})` with skus{childId:SKU}; updateproductimage=false, so child SKUs have no own image - only family gallery images (media/catalog/product/cache/2/image/2500x/...).
est_products: unknown on official site; ~2,073 Diode LED SKUs on Gladiator Lighting (one product per SKU)
sku_format_match: yes on SKU codes (DI-... exact), but official images are per product family, not per SKU

sample_tests.note: official: listed in spConfig of https://www.diodeled.com/advatek-s-pixlite-led-pixel-controllers.html, family images only
official: in spConfig of https://www.diodeled.com/45-channel-components.html (47 child SKUs, 8 family images)
official: in spConfig of https://www.diodeled.com/neon-blaze.html (54 child SKUs, 10 family images)

alternatives.name: Gladiator Lighting
alternatives.endpoint: https://gladiatorlighting.com/collections/diode-led/products.json?limit=250&page=N (9 pages, 2,073 products, 1 variant each, variant.sku = Diode LED SKU)
alternatives.notes: 12/12 sample SKUs matched exactly on variant sku, all with product images (product.images, not variant featured_image). Images on cdn.shopify.com, resizable. Authorization status not verified (retailer).

recommended_strategy: Harvest Gladiator Lighting /collections/diode-led/products.json (9 requests), map variants[].sku (uppercased) -> product.images[*].src; this gave 12/12 sample matches. Use the official diodeled.com only as fallback: search catalogsearch/result/?q=<SKU>, open the family page, confirm SKU in spConfig.skus and take the family image (lower specificity).
blockers: Official site has no per-SKU images (configurable products with updateproductimage=false).
